NORTH CENTRAL PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Hon. Governor of the North Central Province

By virtue of powers vested in me under Section 32(1) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, I, Karunaratna Divulgane,Governor of the North Central Province, hereby notify that the officers named below were appointed to the respective postsindicated in the North Central Provincial Public Service.
1. Mrs. S. M. S. Tennakoon – SLAS, Special Grade – as the Secretary to the Governor of the North Central
Province from 11.06.2014, until further notice.
2. Mr. R. M. Wanninayaka – SLAS, Special Grade – as the Secretary to the North Central Provincial Public
Service Commission, from 11.06.2014, until further notice.
3. Mr. R. G. A. Kularathna - SLAS, Special Grade – as the Secretary to the North Central Provincial Ministry of
Agriculture, Agro Product, Marketing, Animal Production, Animal Health, Fisheries, Environment and ProvincialCouncil Affairs, from 11.08.2014, until further notice.
4. Mr. L. J. M. G. C. Bandara - SLAS, Grade I – as the Secretary to the North Central Provincial Chief Ministry and

the Ministry of Provincial Law and order, Finance and Planning, Local Government Provincial Irrigation,Provincial Road Development, Rural Intra – Structure Facilities, Sports and Youth Affairs, from 11.08.2014,until further notice.
5. Mrs. D.H.M.N.P. Dasanayaka - SLAS, Grade I – to discharge the functions of the post of Secretary to the
North Central Provincial Ministry of Co-operative, Trade and Food, Small Industries Textile Industries, RuralDevelopment and Tourism, from 11.08.2014, until further notice.
6. Mr. P. K. Jayalath - SLAS, Grade I – as Deputy Chief Secretary (Administration) of the North Central Provincial
Chief Secretary Office from 14.08.2014, until further notice.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www. documents.gov.lk

7. Mr. P. A. D. M. D. Ponweera – SL Accountant’s Service, Grade I as Chief Accountant (Finance and Revenue)
of the North Central Provincial Chief Secretary Office (Provincial Treasury), from 07.08.2014, until furthernotice.
8. Mr. D. B. Jayasekara (Retired) – Inland Revenue Service, Class I – as North Central Provincial Commissioner
of Revenue, for a six – month period from 09.07.2014 to 09.01.2015 on contract basic.
9. Mr. R. M. K. B. Ratnayaka – SLAS Grade III – to act in the post of North Central Director of Rural Development
for the period from 02.03.2014 to 02.09.2014.
10. Miss. W. M. U. Weerasinghe – SLAS – Grade III – to discharge the functions of the post of the commissioner
of Central Provincial Cooperation Service Commission, from 03.03.2014 until further notice, in addition to thefunctions of the permanent post holding at present.
11. Mr. T. M. K. B. Premathilaka – SLAS Grade III – to act in the post of North Central Provincial Commissioner and
Register, of Cooperative Development for the period from 20.05.2014 to 30.11.2014 in addition to the functionsof the permanent post holding at present.
12. Miss. W. M. U. Weerasinghe - SLAS – Grade III – to discharge the functions of the post of North Central
Provincial Rural Development Director from 04.09.2014 until further notice, in addition to the functions of thepermanent post holding at present.
13. Mr. E. G. U. Rajapaksha - SLAS – Grade III – to discharge the functions of the post of North Central Provincial
Motor Traffic Commissioner, from 26.08.2014 until further notice, in addition to the functions of the permanentpost holding at present.
14. Miss. W. M. U. Weerasinghe - SLAS – Grade III – to discharge the functions of the post of Secretary to the
North Central Provincial Cooperative Service Commission, from 04.09.2014 until further notice.
15. Mr. P. G. S. K. Somarathna - SLAS – Grade III – to discharge the functions of the post of North Central
Provincial Cultural Director from 05.09.2014 until further notice, in addition to the functions of the postholding at present.
16. Dr. W. M. Palitha Bandara Sri Lanka Medical Administrative Service – to cover the functions of the post of the
Director of Health Services of the North Central Province from 03.03.2014 on temporary basic.
17. Mr. K. G. S. P. Weerakoon – SL Accountant’s Service, Grade I – to act in the post of North Central Provincial
Chief Internal Auditor from 21.11.2014 until further notice, in addition to the functions of the permanent postholding at present.
18. Mrs. M. G. Nadeeka Dilrukshi – SLAS, Grade III – to discharge the functions of the post of North Central
Provincial Commissioner and Register of Cooperative Development from 01.12.2014, until further notice inaddition to the functions of the permanent post holding at present.
KARUNARATHNA DIVULGANE,
Governor,North Central Province.Governor’s Office,North Central Province,31st December, 2014.
